name: Superheating Flames
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level: sorcerer/wizard 8

Components: V,S

Casting Time: 1 standard action

Range: Medium (50 ft. + 10 ft./level)

Target(s): One creature

Duration: See text

Saving Throw: Reflex half (See text); Spell Resistance: yes

This spell immolates the target in a burst of incredibly hot fire, dealing 10d4 points of damage per caster level (maximum 20d4), Reflex for half. Additionally, if the target fails its Reflex save, it must make a Will save or become affected by a heat metal spell.
